reference_audio_urls.title: Reference Audio URLs
reference_audio_urls.description: Optional audio references for the continuation (2–15 seconds each, 15 seconds combined). The full extended video retains its original source soundtrack, and its ending still conditions the transition. These clips guide the newly generated audio instead of using that soundtrack as an audio reference. Assign each clip a role in the prompt, such as 'Audio 1 for the voice' and 'Audio 2 for background music'.

output.title: Output
output.description: 'extended' returns the source and new footage as one video. 'continuation' returns a clip that starts with a 1.625-second repeat of the source's ending, then shows the new footage.

video_url.title: Video Url
video_url.description: URL of the video to extend. Must be 1.625 s to 60 s long, up to 50 MB, aspect ratio between 0.4 and 2.5.

enable_prompt_expansion.title: Enable Prompt Expansion
enable_prompt_expansion.description: Automatically enhance the prompt using the source video to help keep the continuation consistent. May increase processing time.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: Moderate the source video and the prompt.

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. 'auto' follows the source video. Other values crop the video to fit the selected ratio.

prompt.title: Prompt
examples: The red panda keeps walking along the log, then looks up at a bird.
prompt.description: What happens next. Describe the continuation, not the source.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Seconds of new footage to add. The continuation clip also includes 1.625 seconds from the source's ending and may be longer because of frame rounding.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Seed for the continuation. Random when omitted.

mask_video_url.title: Mask Video Url
mask_video_url.description: Input video to mask erase object from. duration must be less than 5s.

auto_trim.title: Auto Trim

preserve_audio.title: Preserve Audio
preserve_audio.description: If true, audio will be preserved in the output video.

output_container_and_codec.title: Output Container And Codec
output_container_and_codec.description: Output container and codec. Options: mp4_h265, mp4_h264, webm_vp9, gif, mov_h264, mov_h265, mov_proresks, mkv_h264, mkv_h265, mkv_vp9, mkv_mpeg4.

input_schema.title: VideoBgrmInput

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: Output video format. Auto-detected if not set (defaults to webm_vp9 for transparent). Transparent backgrounds need webm_vp9, mov_h265, mov_proresks, mkv_vp9 or gif. Transparent MOV is meant for Apple players and editing tools; browser previews, especially Chrome, may show edge halos or no transparency. Use webm_vp9 for transparent web playback.

background.title: Background
background.description: Output background: transparent, a named preset color, or 'custom' to use the background_color color picker.

background_color.title: RGBColor
background_color.description: Custom solid background color (only used when background='custom').

input_schema.description: Input model for video background removal.

recover_detail.description: Recover original detail level (0.0-1.0). Higher values preserve more original detail.
recover_detail.title: Recover Detail

video_url.description: URL of the video to upscale
video_url.title: Video Url

compression.description: Compression artifact removal level (0.0-1.0). Default varies by model.
compression.title: Compression

model.title: Model
model.description: Precision (non-generative) enhancement model. Proteus fits most real-world footage; Proteus Natural is a softer variant; Iris recovers faces; Dione deinterlaces legacy/interlaced sources; Artemis denoises and sharpens degraded footage; Gaia refines high-quality footage and CG (Gaia 2 upscales animation at 2x); Rhea maximizes fine detail via an internal 4x pass; Theia gives manual detail/fidelity control.

halo.description: Halo reduction level (0.0-1.0). Default varies by model.
halo.title: Halo

noise.description: Noise reduction level (0.0-1.0). Default varies by model.
noise.title: Noise

H264_output.description: Whether to use H264 codec for output video. Default is H265.
H264_output.title: H264 Output

grain.description: Film grain amount (0.0-0.1). Default varies by model.
grain.title: Grain

upscale_factor.title: Upscale Factor
upscale_factor.description: Factor to upscale the video by (e.g. 2.0 doubles width and height)

target_fps.description: Target FPS for the output. Frame interpolation is enabled only when this differs from the source FPS.
target_fps.title: Target Fps

slowdown_factor.title: Slowdown Factor
slowdown_factor.description: Slow-motion factor: 2 makes the output twice as long at the target FPS (2x slow motion), up to 8x. 1 keeps the original speed. The extra generated frames are billed like interpolated frames.

H264_output.description: Whether to use H264 codec for output video. Default is H265.
H264_output.title: H264 Output

video_url.description: URL of the video to retime / interpolate
video_url.title: Video Url

model.title: Model
model.description: Frame interpolation model. Apollo is general-purpose; Chronos targets real-world motion; Aion handles extreme/complex motion.

target_fps.title: Target Fps
target_fps.description: Target frames per second for the interpolated output.
